fields.name: Siddha Bābā of Nandagrāma (Yaśodā-kuṇḍa)
fields.aka: Siddha Bābā of Nandagrāma, Nandagrāmera Janaika Bābājī
fields.place: A cave on the bank of Yaśodā-kuṇḍa, near Nandīśvara (Nandagrāma)
fields.notes: An unnamed, completely renounced Vaiṣṇava who did bhajana in a cave by Yaśodā-kuṇḍa near Nandagrāma. A ghost in the form of a dog — once the priest of the Nandīśvara temple — told him to wait for the last cowherd boy coming home; it was Kṛṣṇa, who showed him His three-fold bending form and then the Divine Couple with the sakhīs. He left his body soon after. Told by Rāmadāsa Bābājī to Haridāsa dāsa. (The other bābā of the same text, of Paurṇamāsī-kuṇḍa, has his own record since 11-11-2026.)

fields.appearance: 1655/56, at Baladākhān (Dhaka) (the record's text; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna)
fields.place: Born at Baladākhān (Dhaka); Biyājitpur (Daulatpur, Nadia); Bhuiṅkhālī (Pabna; his śrīpāṭa)
fields.guru: Of Nityānanda Prabhu's parivāra (his guru is not named)
fields.notes: Son of Tārācāṅd Bhāgyavanta of Baladākhān; of Nityānanda's parivāra, though some forefathers were of Advaita's circle. Always carried the Deity Śrī Keśavarāya, given (it is said) in his former birth as Śukadeva Gosvāmī of Advaita's house to a disciple who kept Him until Balarāma came. Refused the Nawab of Murshidabad's zamindārī, took 20 bighās at Biyājitpur, and settled at Bhuiṅkhālī (Pabna) at the Mahārāja of Nāṭor's request. Sons: Nandakiśora and Saccidānanda (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

fields.name: Harisundara Bhaumik (Kāyāda, Pabna)
fields.aka: Harisundara Bhaumik (Bhuina) Of Pabna, Harisundara Bhuiṅyā
fields.appearance: About 1830 (he died at 65 in 1895: the record's text)
fields.disappearance: Kṛṣṇa-ekādaśī of Kārttika, 1895, in Vṛndāvana (the record's text)
fields.guru: Of Narottama Ṭhākura's line by family tradition (his guru is not named)
fields.notes: Son of Kṛṣṇamohana Bhaumik, of Narottama's line by family tradition. A householder who reached bhāva-bhakti; śikṣā-guru of Rājarṣi Vanamālī Rāya Bāhādur (from 1890), with whom he lived at Banwārīnagara and, from 1894, in Vṛndāvana. Taught: «never do anything without Rādhārāṇī's approval». Foretold his death to Kāminī Ghoṣ and died in Vṛndāvana, aged 65, on the kṛṣṇa-ekādaśī of Kārttika 1895.
